nodes.name: Facebook Intake Fetch1
nodes.notes: Reads unprocessed FacebookIntake rows (one row = one weekly client submission). Assign the Airtable token credential, then wire output -> Facebook Parse.

nodes.name: Facebook Parse1
nodes.notes: Parses each submission's Events blob into per-event items (intermediate shape). Wire output -> Merge (new input index). uniqueEventID/_valid recomputed downstream.

nodes.name: Facebook Validity Override1
nodes.notes: Facebook intake exception: feed screenshots carry no event URLs, so FB events arrive linkless and Make UniqueEventID flags _valid=false (missing_url). Let them through if they have a date; the editor adds the link at selection, and a pre-publish guard blocks featuring a linkless item. All other sources still require a URL. See GH #67.

nodes.name: BiblioCommons RSS Fetch1
nodes.notes: Replaces an HTTP Request node. BiblioCommons' WAF blocks Node's default TLS cipher order (403) regardless of headers, so this presents Chrome's cipher ordering. Outputs { data: <xml> } to match what BiblioCommons Normalize1 reads.
